acceptanceCriteria: After a ctest profile run, the caller's build directory has no new or changed files (test asserts it).
The evidence and receipt still retain the CTest log from the run's own directory.
body: Found by the V1-0593 native runner lane (beamfall/corvint#1001, head 20b4c6e0e, 2026-10-17, macOS 26 arm64). Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/native-2026-10-17/cases/. Running the ctest profile leaves Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log (and related files) in the caller's build tree. A run should not mutate the build directory outside its declared output or temp root (TRE cleanup / no-residue expectations). Expected: direct CTest's output and log to the run's own temp/output dir (e.g. --output-log or a scratch build copy), or declare and clean the residue.
